hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Cross-asset stress, elevated advisory risk, and broadly weak or marginally positive signals warrant defensive sizing. BTC is the most resilient but remains exposed to regime risk. ETH and SOL carry higher beta and volatility with weak alpha. BCH is especially fragile due to sharply negative alpha, institutional score, liquidity, and the largest expected shortfall. ETC has an invalid zero price and unusable risk inputs; treat its signal as untrustworthy and do not add exposure. DOGE and LTC lack constructive evidence, with LTC particularly impaired by very poor liquidity.
